town_description: Dibrugarh is Upper Assam's largest city, known as the 'Tea City of India', set on the south bank of the Brahmaputra. It is a commercial hub of the tea, oil and gas industries and home to Dibrugarh University and the Assam Medical College.

travel.airport: Dibrugarh Airport (Mohanbari, DBR), about 15 km from the city centre
travel.railway: Dibrugarh Town and Dibrugarh (DBRT) railway stations
travel.road: NH-15 and NH-515 connect Dibrugarh to Tinsukia, Jorhat and Guwahati
